description: A metal fastening attached across the fore-edge of a volume to hold the covers closed and the leaves pressed flat. It is favoured on books whose pages will otherwise spring open, and a low-profile pattern is chosen so nothing protrudes to scuff a neighbouring spine on the shelf.
name: clasp

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (1901), Chapter XVIII, p.259. Internet Archive.
